text: 阿哈酒馆是面向 DSH Web 客户端的沉浸式角色扮演插件，通过筹备、单聊、群聊和写书等模式组织角色扮演流程。它注册酒馆命令和模式处理器，可创建角色卡、维护角色记忆、安排多人情景对话，并把聊天整理成书稿。用户还可接入 ComfyUI 为剧情生成插画，配置语音服务朗读角色台词。适合希望在 DSH 会话中持续扮演角色并保存故事的用户；图像和语音功能需配置对应服务。

Aha Tavern brings roleplay to DSH Web through setup, solo chat, group scenes, and book writing. Create character cards, build scenes, and preserve memories. Connect ComfyUI for illustrations and a speech service for dialogue. Compile chats into books and export Markdown.

阿哈酒馆的功能「角色扮演模式」：通过筹备、单聊和群聊模式创建角色卡、设定情景并与角色互动；使用对应模式和 /aha 命令触发。
阿哈酒馆的功能「情景群聊」：设置在场角色与情景后开展多人角色对话，可通过旁白改变局面、换场或结束一场戏。
阿哈酒馆的功能「角色记忆」：聊天可保存角色与用户的互动记录，并通过记忆命令让角色记下一句话或回顾整理往事。
阿哈酒馆的功能「剧情插画」：角色可调用已配置的 ComfyUI 工作流生成图片，也可用重新生图命令调整上一张图。
阿哈酒馆的功能「聊天写书」：选择聊天与叙述人称后逐节整理故事，可继续改写成小说并导出 Markdown。

aha-tavern README · 阿哈酒馆 Aha Tavern：中文 | [English](README.en.md)

> 听说那世界尽头的酒馆墙面写着"阿哈禁止入内"，这阿哈也太没有面子了。问题不大，咱直接开一个。

aha-tavern README · 简介：

阿哈酒馆是一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件，把角色扮演做成编码智能体里的几个"模式"，而不是另起一个网页应用。你选一个文件夹当酒馆，在里面建角色、和角色聊天、拉几个角色演一场群戏，最后把聊过的故事整理成一本书。 剧情走到值得留下的画面时，角色会调用你的 ComfyUI 画一张图；配好语音服务后，每个角色用自己的声音把台词念出来。生图和语音都是你自己部署的外部服务，插件只负责编排。聊天记录、记忆、图片、书稿都以普通文件存在酒馆文件夹里，卸载插件也不会丢。 > **项目研发状态：文字聊天、群聊、写书都可用，生图和台词语音也可用。** 已经能开店、建角色卡、写主角档案、和角色单聊、拉几个角色同台群聊、把聊过的故事写成书、让角色记事；配好 ComfyUI 后，角色还能按剧情画图；配好语音服务后，角色的台词可以念出来。项目初期阶段，欢迎反馈。

aha-tavern README · 四个模式：| 模式 | 做什么 |
|---|---|
| **酒馆:筹备** | 开店、建角色卡、写主角档案和世界观、给角色定妆和配声音、从别的酒馆导入 |
| **酒馆:单聊** | 和一个角色聊天，角色记得你们之间的事 |
| **酒馆:群聊** | 几个角色同台，一个模型演全场，旁白交代环境和局面 |
| **酒馆:写书** | 把聊过的几场整理成书，还能再改写成小说 |

一个会话只做一件事：选了哪个模式就只做那个模式的事。每个模式只挂自己需要的工具，不挂编码工具，提示词保持精简。

aha-tavern README · 特性：**角色与记忆**

- 角色卡定义人设、说话方式与出场白；可以对掌柜说一句话起草，也可以贴一段现成的人设，或者给一张图让掌柜看图起草（模型需支持图片输入）
- 筹备里自带联网搜索（可关），给有出处的角色建卡时可以让掌柜查资料
- 记忆分三层：主线记忆常驻、往事梗概按需回忆、原始记录逐句落盘。角色会自己记下要紧的事，你也可以用命令让 TA 记住
- 单聊和群聊的记忆是连通的：群聊里发生的事，之后单聊时角色记得，也能回忆起来

**群聊**

- 定好谁在场、什么情景就开场；旁白以【旁白】开头，角色以"名字："开头，每轮最多三个人开口
- `@角色名` 点名只让一个人回应；`/aha 旁白` 让局面起变化，角色听不到这句要求
- 地点或时间变了，旁白会问你要不要换场；换场时可以有人来有人走，收场时给这一场起标题

**写书**

- 选几场聊天和人称，编辑起草目录，你在对话里改到满意
- 插件在后台逐节写整理稿：台词基本是原话，删去命令和出戏的部分
- 可以再按你描述的文风改写成小说：合并、重排小节，加序言
- 任意一节都能单独重写，最后导出成一整本 Markdown

**生图**

aha-tavern README · 特性：- 先画后说：图片显示在这一轮回复的第一行，正文跟在下面；角色只在值得留下的时刻画，闲聊不画
- 给角色定一张三视图定妆图，之后每张图都照它来，保持长相一致；需要时可以加多套形象
- 群聊里有场景图和单人特写两种画法
- 也可以直接说"画一张"，或者用 `/aha 重新生图` 换一张、按要求改画面

**语音**

- 每个角色有自己的声音：自备一段录音，或者按描述让掌柜设计一个
- 手动朗读，或每轮自动朗读；动作和神态写在括号里，不念出来；群聊里旁白和各个角色按各自的声音念
- 苹果芯片的 Mac 上，插件能替你装好并启动本机语音服务（Qwen3-TTS）；其他平台连自己部署的 OpenAI 兼容语音服务

**主题**

- 自带"愚者"（默认）与"直白"两套称呼和口吻，只换叫法，不换数据

aha-tavern README · 安装：从 [v0.1.0-rc1 预发布](https://github.com/LanceLRQ/dsh-aha-tavern/releases/tag/v0.1.0-rc1)下载安装包，装进你用的 profile（下面以 `web` 为例）：

```bash
curl -fLO https://github.com/LanceLRQ/dsh-aha-tavern/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc1/aha-tavern-0.1.0-rc1.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add ./aha-tavern-0.1.0-rc1.tgz
```

Release 同时提供 `.sha256` 校验文件。升级时下载新版本的安装包，再执行同一条 `add` 命令。

重启 `dsh web`，新建会话时模式列表里会多出四个酒馆模式。用 `dsh plugin add` 安装后，插件页里还有一个"阿哈酒馆"设置页，可以改生图和语音的配置、启停本机语音服务。完整步骤见[使用指南](docs/getting-started.md)。

运行时需要：

aha-tavern README · 安装：- DSH（已验证兼容 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.1`）
- 一个能用的模型（本地模型或在线模型都行）
- 想让角色画图：一个 ComfyUI，见[配置生图](docs/image-setup.md)
- 想让角色开口：苹果芯片的 Mac 加 uv，或者一个自己部署的 OpenAI 兼容语音服务，见[配置语音](docs/voice-setup.md)

后两项都不配也能正常聊天，只是角色不画图、不出声。

aha-tavern README · 使用：先在"酒馆:筹备"里开店、建角色，再新开"酒馆:单聊"会话开场：

```
/aha 启动
/aha 角色 白狐
```

```
/aha 开场 星神☆阿哈(欠债版)
你就是阿哈帕？这是你的账单，快点还钱帕！
……
/aha 记忆 我不吃香菜

群聊和写书各开一个新会话，选对应的模式，工作区选同一个酒馆文件夹。群聊用 `/aha 开场` 定下谁在场、什么情景；写书用 `/aha 写书` 选要收入的聊天，之后和编辑在对话里定目录、开写。

子命令中英文等价，也可以写成独立命令：`/aha 开场` = `/aha start` = `/aha-start`。

aha-tavern README · 使用：| 命令 | 在哪个模式 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `/aha 启动` | 筹备 | 把当前工作区变成一间酒馆 |
| `/aha 角色 [角色名]` | 筹备 | 新建或修改角色卡 |
| `/aha 我` | 筹备 | 写或改主角档案 |
| `/aha 世界观` | 筹备 | 写或改世界观 |
| `/aha 定妆 [角色名]` | 筹备 | 给角色定一张定妆图，之后画的图都照它来 |
| `/aha 导入` | 筹备 | 从另一间酒馆复制角色卡或主角档案 |
| `/aha 开场 [角色名…] [情景]` | 单聊、群聊 | 单聊：选定角色开始聊天；群聊：定下谁在场、什么情景，开始一场 |
| `/aha 旁白 [要求]` | 群聊 | 让旁白改变环境或局面，例如 `/aha 旁白 让气氛紧张一点` |
| `/aha 换场 [新情景] [谁来谁走]` | 群聊 | 换一个场景，可以同时增减在场的人 |
| `/aha 收场` | 群聊 | 给这一场写梗概并起标题，之后还能接着聊 |
| `/aha 记忆 [内容]` | 单聊、群聊 | 记一句话，或让角色回顾并整理记忆；群聊里可用 `@角色名` 只记给某个人 |
| `/aha 重新生图 [修改要求]` | 单聊、群聊 | 按原画面换一张；带上修改要求，角色会改写画面描述后重画 |
| `/aha 朗读 [文字\|开\|关\|停]` | 单聊、群聊 | 念上一轮回复，或念给定的文字；`开` / `关` 切换这场聊天的自动朗读，`停` 停止朗读 |
| `/aha 写书 [书名]` | 写书 | 开一本书：选要收入的聊天与人称 |
| `/aha 进度` | 写书 | 看书写到哪了 |
| `/aha 停笔` | 写书 | 停下正在写的那一节，已写好的保留 |
| `/aha 导出 [整理稿\|小说]` | 写书 | 把整本书拼成 Markdown 文件；不带参数时两份都导 |
| `/aha 自检` | 都可以 | 检查当前状态；`/aha 自检 生图`、`/aha 自检 语音` 看详情 |
| `/aha 语音 [启动\|停止\|状态]` | 都可以 | 启动、停止或查看本机语音服务 |
aha-tavern README · 使用：中文子命令有几个同义写法，效果一样：`启动` 也可以写 `开店`、`开张`；`角色` 也可以写 `角色卡`、`建卡`；`记忆` 也可以写 `记住`；`朗读` 也可以写 `说话`；`重新生图` 也可以写 `重掷`。

aha-tavern README · 数据在哪：酒馆就是你选作工作区的那个文件夹，里面有角色（`characters/`）、聊天（`chats/`）、书（`books/`）、世界观和主角档案，全是 YAML、JSONL、Markdown 和图片这样的普通文件，可以直接打开看、改、备份。全局只有一份很小的登记表 `~/.dsh/aha-tavern/taverns.yaml`，记你开过哪几间酒馆。目录结构见[使用指南](docs/getting-started.md)的"数据在哪"。

aha-tavern README · Aha Tavern：[中文](README.md) | English

> A DSH plugin for role-play chat, group scenes, book writing, illustrations and voiced dialogue.

aha-tavern README · Introduction：

Aha Tavern is a plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness). It turns role-play into a few "modes" inside a coding agent, instead of being a separate web app. You pick a folder as your tavern, create characters in it, chat with them, stage group scenes with several characters, and finally turn the stories you have played into a book.

aha-tavern README · Introduction：When the story reaches a moment worth keeping, the character calls your ComfyUI to draw a picture. Once a voice service is set up, each character speaks their lines in their own voice. Image generation and voice are external services that you run yourself; the plugin only orchestrates them. Chats, memories, images and manuscripts are plain files in the tavern folder, and they stay put if you uninstall the plugin.

aha-tavern README · Introduction：> **Project status: text chat, group chat and book writing all work, and so do images and voiced dialogue.** You can already open a tavern, create character cards, write your player profile, chat one-on-one, run group scenes, write your stories into a book, and let characters remember things. With ComfyUI set up, characters can draw pictures as the story goes; with a voice service set up, their lines can be read aloud. The project is at an early stage, and feedback is welcome.
aha-tavern README · Four modes：The mode names appear in the DSH interface in Chinese, so they are shown below with the original text in parentheses.

aha-tavern README · Four modes：| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Tavern: Setup** (酒馆:筹备) | Open a tavern, create character cards, write your profile and the world, make reference sheets and set up voices for characters, import from another tavern |
| **Tavern: Chat** (酒馆:单聊) | Chat with one character who remembers what happened between you |
| **Tavern: Group** (酒馆:群聊) | Several characters on stage, one model plays them all, and a narrator sets the scene |
| **Tavern: Book** (酒馆:写书) | Turn several past chats into a book, and optionally rewrite it as a novel |
aha-tavern README · Four modes：A session does one thing: whichever mode you pick is all it does. Each mode loads only the tools it needs, with no coding tools, and the system prompt stays small.

aha-tavern README · Features：- A character card defines the persona, speaking style and opening line. You can describe a character to the host in a sentence, paste an existing persona, or give an image and let the host draft the card from it (the model must accept image input)
- Setup has built-in web search (can be turned off), so the host can look things up when you create a card for a character from an existing work
- Memory has three layers: core memory is always in the prompt, recaps are recalled on demand, and the transcript is written to disk line by line. Characters note down what matters on their own, and you can also tell them to remember something with a command
- Chat and group chat share memory: what happened in a group scene is remembered by the characters later in one-on-one chat, and they can recall it

aha-tavern README · Features：**Group chat**

- Decide who is present and what the scenario is, then start. The narrator's lines start with 【旁白】 (narrator), characters' lines start with "Name:", and at most three characters speak per turn
- `@name` makes only that one character respond; `/aha narrator` changes the situation, and the characters cannot hear the request
- When the place or time changes, the narrator asks whether to change scene. A scene change can bring people in or out, and at wrap-up the scene gets a title

aha-tavern README · Features：**Book writing**

- Choose some chats and a point of view; the editor drafts an outline, and you refine it in conversation
- The plugin then writes the draft section by section in the background: dialogue is mostly verbatim, with commands and out-of-character parts removed
- You can then rewrite it as a novel in a style you describe: merge and reorder sections, add a preface
- Any section can be rewritten on its own, and the whole book exports as one Markdown file

**Images**

aha-tavern README · Features：- Draw first, then speak: the image shows on the first line of the reply, with the text below it. Characters only draw at moments worth keeping, not during small talk
- Give a character a three-view reference sheet and every later image follows it, so the face stays consistent. You can add more looks when needed
- Group chat has two kinds of images: scene images and single-character close-ups
- You can also just say "draw one", or use `/aha reroll` to get another one or to change the picture on request

aha-tavern README · Features：**Voice**

- Every character has their own voice: bring a recording, or have the host design one from a description
- Read aloud by hand, or automatically every turn. Actions and expressions in parentheses are not read; in group chat the narrator and each character use their own voices
- On an Apple-silicon Mac the plugin can install and start a local voice service (Qwen3-TTS) for you; on other platforms it connects to an OpenAI-compatible voice service you run yourself

**Themes**
aha-tavern README · Features：- Two built-in sets of terms and tone: "Fools" (愚者, the default) and "Plain" (直白). They change names and wording only, not your data

aha-tavern README · Installation：Download the package from the [v0.1.0-rc1 prerelease](https://github.com/LanceLRQ/dsh-aha-tavern/releases/tag/v0.1.0-rc1) and install it into the profile you use (`web` below):

```bash
curl -fLO https://github.com/LanceLRQ/dsh-aha-tavern/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc1/aha-tavern-0.1.0-rc1.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add ./aha-tavern-0.1.0-rc1.tgz
```

The release also includes a `.sha256` checksum file. To upgrade, download the new package and run the same `add` command.

aha-tavern README · Installation：Restart `dsh web`. When you create a new session, the mode list now has four tavern modes. If you installed with `dsh plugin add`, the plugin page also has an "Aha Tavern" (阿哈酒馆) settings page, where you can change the image and voice settings and start or stop the local voice service. For the full steps see the [Getting started guide](docs/en/getting-started.md).

You need:

aha-tavern README · Installation：- DSH (tested with `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.1`)
- A working model (local or online)
- To let characters draw: a ComfyUI, see [Image setup](docs/en/image-setup.md)
- To let characters speak: an Apple-silicon Mac with uv, or an OpenAI-compatible voice service you run yourself, see [Voice setup](docs/en/voice-setup.md)

Chat works without the last two; characters just don't draw or speak.

aha-tavern README · Usage：First open a tavern and create a character in Tavern: Setup, then start a new Tavern: Chat session and begin:

```
/aha init
/aha card 白狐
```

(白狐 is an example character name.)

```
/aha start 白狐
...
/aha remember I don't eat cilantro
```

aha-tavern README · Usage：For group chat and book writing, open a new session each, pick the matching mode, and choose the same tavern folder as the workspace. In group chat, use `/aha start` to decide who is present and what the scenario is. For book writing, use `/aha book` to choose the chats to include, then work out the outline with the editor in conversation and start writing.

aha-tavern README · Usage：Subcommands accept both Chinese and English, and can also be written as standalone commands: `/aha 开场` = `/aha start` = `/aha-start`. The examples in the English docs use the English forms.

aha-tavern README · Usage：| Command (Chinese) | Command (English) | Mode | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/aha 启动` | `/aha init` | Setup | Turn the current workspace into a tavern |
| `/aha 角色 [name]` | `/aha card [name]` | Setup | Create or edit a character card |
| `/aha 我` | `/aha me` | Setup | Write or edit your player profile |
| `/aha 世界观` | `/aha world` | Setup | Write or edit the world |
| `/aha 定妆 [name]` | `/aha look [name]` | Setup | Make a reference sheet for a character; later images follow it |
| `/aha 导入` | `/aha import` | Setup | Copy character cards or your profile from another tavern |
| `/aha 开场 [name…] [scenario]` | `/aha start [name…] [scenario]` | Chat, Group | Chat: pick a character and start. Group: decide who is present and the scenario, and start a scene |
| `/aha 旁白 [request]` | `/aha narrator [request]` | Group | Have the narrator change the surroundings or the situation, e.g. `/aha narrator make the mood tense` |
| `/aha 换场 [new scenario] [who comes or goes]` | `/aha scene [new scenario] [who comes or goes]` | Group | Change scene; people can join or leave at the same time |
| `/aha 收场` | `/aha wrap` | Group | Write a recap and a title for this sce

aha-tavern README · Usage：The Chinese subcommands have a few synonyms with the same effect: `启动` can also be written `开店` or `开张`; `角色` can also be written `角色卡` or `建卡`; `记忆` can also be written `记住`; `朗读` can also be written `说话`; `重新生图` can also be written `重掷`.

aha-tavern README · Where your data lives：The tavern is the folder you pick as the workspace. It holds the characters (`characters/`), chats (`chats/`), books (`books/`), the world and your profile, all as plain YAML, JSONL, Markdown and image files that you can open, edit and back up directly. The only global file is a small registry, `~/.dsh/aha-tavern/taverns.yaml`, which lists the taverns you have opened. For the directory layout see "Where your data lives" in the [Getting started guide](docs/en/getting-started.md).

aha-tavern README · Documentation：- [Getting started](docs/en/getting-started.md): install, open a tavern, create characters, chat, memory, group chat, book writing, images, voice, data layout, themes
- [Image setup](docs/en/image-setup.md): ComfyUI model files, `services.yaml`, self-check, GGUF, built-in workflows, reference sheets, troubleshooting
- [Voice setup](docs/en/voice-setup.md): starting and downloading the local voice service, giving characters voices, reading aloud, self-check, running your own voice service, troubleshooting

aha-tavern README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build       # bundle the plugin and the settings page
pnpm test        # unit tests
pnpm typecheck   # type check

To publish, update the version in `package.json` and push a matching `v<version>` tag. GitHub Actions checks the version, runs type checking and unit tests, then packages the plugin and creates a release. Versions with a prerelease suffix are marked as prereleases.

aha-tavern README · Development：For local debugging you don't need to install: copy `examples/dev.example.yml` to `examples/dev.yml`, change the paths in it to absolute paths of this repository, then start with `dsh web --patch <absolute path>/examples/dev.yml`. The settings page is not visible this way.
